fields.name: count
fields.desc: number of records

desc: Character encyclopedia (Records/zukan), 94 entries (story + generic classes + DLC guests). Each entry: name, char.dat id, 5 pages x 5 unlock-flag slots, and 5 pages x 10 lines x 5 languages of 84-byte text slots starting at +0x120 (line-major, language-minor interleave). Baseline string detection was misaligned (it started at the EN line); fixed here.

fields.name: id
fields.desc: entry id 0..93 (= row index)

fields.name: char_id
fields.desc: character shown for this entry: char.dat id (u32 at char.dat record +0xD0; e.g. 10=Killia, 1010..1015=Warrior tiers)

fields.name: page1_flag1
fields.desc: unlock flag for encyclopedia page 1 (flag id, -1 = none). Slot 1 holds scenario flags (e.g. 101, 701, 1311), FLAG_CHARAMAKE_* (17001..) for generic classes, FLAG_JOIN_* (13600..) or FLAG_DLC_CHARA_HAVE_* (18300..); small values 2..39 on class pages 1 are unnamed flags. Slots 2..5 are -1 in every row (probably extra/alternative flags)

fields.desc: additional unlock flag for page 1 (always -1)
